summary.name: Jam
summary.one_liner: Jam is a screen recording tool for software teams that captures bugs, feedback, and ideas along with available console logs, network requests, and device details.
use_cases: Record a bug with technical context for engineers
Collect customer issue recordings via a shareable link
Triage bugs by routing recordings to Linear, Jira, or Slack
Give a coding agent context to investigate and fix an issue
Publish agent-made walkthrough videos to show PR work
summary.what_it_does: Jam records the screen or captures a screenshot via a Chrome extension, with the recording bundled with available console logs, network requests, user events, and device details. It uses AI to suggest a title, summary, and repro steps for each recording. Jams can be sent to Linear, Jira, or Slack, or into AI tooling, and customers can record issues through a link or via Fin without installing anything. For agents, Jam MCP exposes a Jam's context to coding agents, Jam CLI can publish agent-made videos, and webhooks can trigger agent runs. A JavaScript SDK lets developers add custom metadata such as user, feature flag, and app state.
notable: Attaches console logs, network requests, and user events to each recording automatically
Jam MCP and Jam CLI let coding agents read Jams and publish videos
Recording Links let customers record issues without installing anything
Auto-blur hides matched elements during Recording Link sessions
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Context capture is limited to what is available, per the page wording
Listed in a collection as #free, but the page itself does not state a free tier
